verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a corporate card and spend-management platform, so a mileage and per-diem story is a fair question for it. The evidence covers cards, VCNs, statements, receipt linking, categories and cost centers, but nothing about mileage logging, map-based distance calculation, or per-diem rates. The 'end of spreadsheets' and auto-categorization claims are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an employee, I can log mileage with map-based distance and claim per-diem rates without building the expense by hand
